en.name: The Cat Chorus
en.ability: 1 player is drunk. At dusk, the Storyteller might name a song: if the players sing it together successfully, all Townsfolk are unaffected by poisoning & drunkenness until the next dusk.

zh.name: 猫猫合唱团
zh.ability: 一名玩家醉酒。在黄昏时，说书人可能会指定一首歌曲：如果玩家们成功合唱，所有镇民不受中毒醉酒影响，直到下个黄昏。
